outreach.notes: Awarded BOTH lots for the Expo 2027 COLLECTIVE PAVILIONS: design, engineering, construction, fit-out, operational management, maintenance and dismantling. Total RSD 5.28bn ex-VAT (approx EUR 45m), 6 bidders. Korean exhibition/museum builder (founded 1988, Seongnam), long World Expo track record. Highest-value prospect on the list: the collective pavilions are where the countries WITHOUT their own building exhibit, so this firm is the gatekeeper to a large share of booth-level participants. Source: b92.net/biz/srbija/vesti/255039 (2026-07-31). ALSO holds the Korea Pavilion contract from KOTRA: KRW 8,836,190,000, signed 23 Jun 2026, term to 30 Nov 2027 (eDaily/Nate 24 Jun 2026). Collective-pavilion main contract signed 21 Aug 2026, EUR 54m incl. VAT per Korean press (newspim 24 Aug). Builds both the Korea Pavilion and the shared halls.
